source_locator_policy: Compression items inherit repository+commit+path+blob from explicit source branch; exact section paths are resolved through the listed effective parse unit IDs.
occurrence_accounting_policy: For every multi-unit destination, source occurrence count equals number of listed source units; warrant independence is NOT_ESTABLISHED and warrant multiplicity effect is NONE unless separately warranted. R19 establishes no such independence.
formal_variant_policy: Correction-deficit variants, restoration-threshold variants, both Psi vectors, correction-event criteria variants, and symbol reuse remain distinct source-local branches and are not canonicalized by projection.
execution_standing_policy: Benchmark/experiment specifications, predictions, expected results, and the source label 'Observed phenomenon' acquire no execution/result standing without persisted execution provenance.
external_endpoint_policy: PDM/Azus/other external references remain contextual and unresolved for endpoint identity; projection emits no cross-repository edge.
history_policy: Current-head parse and 23-commit developmental provenance remain distinct reconstructible views.
